us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Trump administration promises $15 billion in farm aid before midterms
bullets: The administration announced farm-support promises weeks before Election Day.
AP says the aid targets higher diesel and fertilizer costs.
The measures come amid political pressure in rural states.

articles.title: Trump administration election posts criticized as inflammatory
bullets: AP reported criticism of official social-media posts before the midterms.
The posts focused on immigration, fraud and public-benefits issues.
Opponents said the messaging risked inflaming political tensions.

articles.title: Virginia and DC sue over Trump memorial arch plan
bullets: Virginia and Washington, DC filed a federal lawsuit Saturday.
The case challenges a proposed memorial arch near Arlington.
The administration said construction could begin as early as next week.

articles.title: Heavy rain raises flooding risk across saturated Southwest
bullets: Forecasters warned of flooding in already saturated areas.
Officials reported multiple water rescues from flooded roads.
Authorities urged drivers to avoid washes and fast-moving water.

articles.title: AP analysis finds Iranian strikes damaged US Mideast bases
bullets: AP verified damage using satellite imagery and regional sources.
Iranian attacks reportedly targeted air defenses, aircraft and buildings.
The analysis covered strikes from April through June.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: G20 foreign ministers end Atlanta meeting without consensus
bullets: Diplomats remained divided on security and supply-chain issues.
European objections to Russia canceled the traditional group photo.
The US separately approved Patriot interceptor sales for Ukraine.

articles.title: Youth-led protests spread across France and Germany
bullets: Thousands rallied in France for a third weekend.
The Guardian reported clashes involving masked rioters and police.
German officers used tear gas as some protests turned violent.

articles.title: Bulgarians vote in presidential runoff amid security concerns
bullets: Bulgaria held a presidential runoff on Sunday.
AP reported regional security threats and economic worries shaped the vote.
The election came during heightened tensions in Eastern Europe.

articles.title: Turkey moves Kurdish militant leader Ocalan during peace push
bullets: Turkey moved Abdullah Ocalan within his island prison.
AP reported the move was linked to renewed peace efforts.
Ocalan remains a central figure in Turkey’s Kurdish conflict.

articles.title: London police arrest 139 outside US Embassy protest
bullets: Police arrested 139 people at a London demonstration.
The protest supported the banned group Palestine Action.
Authorities said the arrests happened outside the US Embassy.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Delhi security tightened before opposition ‘Save Democracy’ march
bullets: Security personnel surrounded Ramlila Maidan on Sunday.
The opposition demanded Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation.
Riot-control vehicles and baton-carrying police were deployed.

articles.title: Indian opposition renews protest against elections chief
bullets: Opposition parties staged fresh protests against the elections chief.
AP described it as public dissent against Modi’s government.
The protests focused on a controversial voter-list revision.

articles.title: Delhi-Haryana border clogs during anti-pollution vehicle checks
bullets: Police turned away non-BS VI vehicles at border points.
The checks were part of anti-pollution restrictions.
Indian Express reported traffic congestion through the day.

articles.title: New Delhi imposes restrictions as pollution worsens
bullets: AFP reported new anti-pollution measures in Delhi.
Steps included higher parking fees and work-from-home mandates.
The goal was reducing traffic emissions in the capital.

articles.title: India beat Japan 4–1 in hockey at Jalandhar
bullets: India defeated Japan 4–1 in Jalandhar.
The win was India’s third from three matches.
India’s next scheduled opponent was Malaysia.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Market movers and Wall Street stories

articles.title: Wall Street drops sharply as AI spending fears hit tech
bullets: Reuters reported a broad Friday selloff in US stocks.
The Nasdaq had its worst daily percentage drop since June 5.
Intel and Amazon results fueled AI cash-burn concerns.

articles.title: Amazon slides after earnings miss despite strong AWS growth
bullets: Amazon shares fell after its earnings report.
AWS posted its fastest growth in years, according to the roundup.
Investors focused on AI spending and free-cash-flow pressure.

articles.title: Glaukos jumps 34% after earnings and outlook boost
bullets: Glaukos was listed as DailyHub’s stock of the day.
Shares rose 33.65% to $242.48.
The move followed strong quarterly results and a higher growth outlook.

articles.title: Fortinet plunges 26% as cybersecurity stocks lose favor
bullets: DailyHub cited Fortinet as a major decliner.
Shares fell 26% despite a reported earnings beat.
The drop reflected weaker sentiment toward security stocks.

articles.title: ADT rallies after Thrive Holdings agrees to buy company
bullets: ADT shares rose 33.20% to $9.87.
Thrive Holdings agreed to acquire ADT at $10 per share.
DailyHub listed ADT among the day’s top gainers.

articles.title: ExxonMobil earnings top estimates on stronger refining margins
bullets: StreetInsider listed ExxonMobil among top corporate headlines.
The report cited diesel and gasoline price strength.
Refining margins helped earnings beat expectations.

articles.title: Trian offers to acquire Wendy’s for about $1.4 billion
bullets: Trian Fund Management offered $7.35 per Wendy’s share.
Axios said the offer valued Wendy’s near $1.4 billion.
The price represented a 20% premium to the prior close.

articles.title: Amazon receives FCC approval for Globalstar acquisition
bullets: Axios reported FCC approval for Amazon’s Globalstar deal.
The transaction was valued at $11.57 billion.
The acquisition expands Amazon’s satellite-based telecom ambitions.

articles.title: Buyers circle luxury fragrance brand Parfums de Marly
bullets: Axios cited Reuters on interest in Parfums de Marly.
CVC, Cinven and Puig were among potential suitors.
Advent International owns the French luxury fragrance brand.

articles.title: Bangladesh to form wage board after garment protests
bullets: Reuters reported Bangladesh will form a wage board.
The decision followed garment-worker protests that shut factories.
The apparel sector is central to Bangladesh’s export economy.

articles.title: Tech giants brace for post-election AI scrutiny
bullets: Axios reported Democrats plan increased scrutiny of tech titans.
AI regulation and market power are expected to be key targets.
OpenAI’s Chris Lehane called Tuesday an “electoral portal.”],

articles.title: FBI blames North Korea for record Binance crypto hack
bullets: AP reported the FBI attributed the theft to North Korea.
Binance said it had covered 90% of stolen funds.
The hack was described as the biggest in history.

articles.title: New York enacts stricter rules for AI chatbots used by children
bullets: New York moved to restrict unsafe companion-chatbot behavior.
The law targets risks to children using AI systems.
States are increasingly setting AI rules without Washington.

articles.title: Anthropic files for potentially record-setting IPO
bullets: Anthropic filed IPO paperwork Monday, AP reported.
The company disclosed huge revenue growth and major losses.
Its filing warned of catastrophic and existential AI risks.

articles.title: Malaysia seizes advanced AI chips hidden in servers
bullets: Officials found AI chips inside 30 servers at Kuala Lumpur airport.
Tom’s Hardware cited Reuters on the October 15 seizure.
Authorities suspected Malaysia was used as a smuggling transit hub.
